Cook questioned the value of Bethell sitting on the IPL bench, though the youngster previously defended his decision to stay at RCB.

title: A fragile fitness system? Hamstring injuries put Team India, CoE under scanner
description: The recurring injuries suffered by Harshit Rana and Nitish Kumar Reddy have not gone down well with the BCCI. Sources said Reddy was being pushed to bowl close to 140kmph to compensate for the injury-prone Hardik Pandya. During Rahul Dravid’s tenure as head coach, the BCCI medical team, the CoE and the team management had charted out year-long roadmaps for individual players around major ICC events. The objective was to get each player to the required fitness level in time for the next ICC tournament or marquee Test series.

Scientists heard bird sounds beneath floating Solar Farm in Netherlands
description: Floating solar farms in the Netherlands may be supporting local wildlife. Researchers observed bird sounds suggesting possible nesting under the solar panels. Underwater shelters installed beneath the panels attracted hundreds of fish and thousands of aquatic creatures. These structures developed into small ecosystems supporting life higher up the food chain. The findings suggest carefully designed farms could create new habitats for wildlife.

title: How 'sluggish' initial response may have led to Monday's mess at CJP-led protest
description: Police faced criticism for inaction during the recent 'Sandad Chalo' march.  Intelligence reports provided advance warning of the large demonstrator build-up.  Officers reported a lack of clear orders during the crucial initial hour.  This hesitation allowed crowds to breach key security perimeters and reach Parliament.  Similar administrative hesitations occurred during past protests at Red Fort and India Gate.

title: Jeff Bezos on returning to work after retirement: I just couldn’t sit on sidelines
description: Jeff Bezos has returned to an operational role to launch his new AI startup, Prometheus.  He describes this demanding work as rewarding, which he calls "Type 2 fun."  Bezos believes artificial intelligence will create a labor shortage, not job losses.  His new venture has secured significant funding and is now his primary focus.  He is energized by the long road ahead as Prometheus scales its operations.
